title: Harden seeded Codex shell-policy parsing and RPC projection
outcome: The Engram thread-level shell_environment_policy overlay currently deserializes the seeded mcp_servers and shell policy as one struct, so a structurally invalid policy can discard otherwise valid user MCP servers. It also forwards unknown policy keys verbatim into the app-server thread config without a pinned contract that the RPC schema tolerates them, and performs the merge through fallible untyped JSON surgery. Decouple the two parse failure domains, verify the pinned Codex app-server behavior for unknown policy keys, and use a typed policy projection/merge so malformed policy data degrades only that policy rather than thread setup or user MCP configuration.
acceptance: Valid seeded mcp_servers survive a malformed or unsupported shell_environment_policy; supported policy fields and the three TermAl-owned ENGRAM_* values produce a typed deterministic thread/start and thread/resume config; unknown-key behavior is verified against the pinned Codex app-server and documented; focused and normal quality gates pass.
